findings.summary: Reuse source graph analysis per checked program and propagate aliases through a work queue.
Bound replacement URL candidates during iteration instead of allocating the Cartesian product.
Reuse the shared return traversal for packaged URL helper bodies.
Share Dawn string-view conversion between adapter metadata and resources.
Use the native fixture runner for async texture execution.
Share nullable async resource projection and defer type mapping past already-owned and tuple cases.
Compute queried markup subtree bounds only when materializing a retained handle.
